source.title: Nazareth Area Food Bank Registration Form

questions.label: Age
questions.note: The applicant's age in years; no saved field holds it (it's worked out from the birth date). Proposed rule: applicantAge.

questions.label: City, State and Zip Code
questions.note: One box for city, state and ZIP together; no single saved field holds all three.

questions.label: In the event that you are unable to pick up your food, please list the name of the person to whom you give permission to pick up your food.
questions.note: Someone else who may pick up food; not in the profile.

questions.label: Proof of residency is required at the NAFB. Please bring two forms of residency listed below.
questions.note: Which proof documents are brought; not in the profile.

questions.label: Please Specify
questions.note: Write-in for an Other proof of residency.

questions.label: Total Number of Adults
questions.note: Adults aren't banded here, so it likely counts everyone 18+; the profile counts adults 18-64 and seniors 65+ separately.

questions.label: Signature
questions.note: Confirms the information and agrees to the NAFB terms and conditions.
